inputs.combatant: hostile monster with a death macro

castleSourceObservation.beforeMacro: killbody calls bodyground and bodyfield, replacing the monster's occupied battlefield cells
castleSourceObservation.macroMutation: CODE 119 sets the death-macro monster stamina to one and allegiance to friendly
castleSourceObservation.afterMacro: killbody skips its ordinary post-macro body replacement but does not restore the revived monster to battlefield occupancy

realmz2ChosenResult.pendingMacro: retain the defeated monster footprint until the death macro completes
realmz2ChosenResult.stillDead: remove the footprint before battle resolution continues
realmz2ChosenResult.revived: retain the original footprint with the revived health and allegiance
realmz2ChosenResult.saveBoundary: every resulting live combatant has one persisted battlefield footprint
